'''Miza''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who was part of the squadron that supported [[Jagged Fel]]'s mission to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], shortly before the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]].

==Biography==
He joined the [[Twin Suns Squadron]] and piloted a [[Nssis-class Clawcraft]]. He was killed when a [[Yevetha]]n [[Unidentified Yevethan pilot|pilot]] set his ship to [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]], and Miza's craft was caught in the blast.<ref name="Remnant" />

==Appearances==
*''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'' {{1st}}
